reviews.title: Great platform, but does not support sellers.
reviews.text: Have been a customer for several years, paying for subscription services including their new gold tier. Have not had many issues, until recently. One, the tracking service used is subpar. A good half of the time, dropped off packages aren’t scanned in or updated appropriately. This leaves it up to buyers honesty, which is usually not apparent. Had several small sales, that were lost in transit. Collx was quick to refund the customer, despite being within 30 days of the purchase and quick to have me out my cards and the money. They also are quick to blame how I shipped it, despite me having shipped with them for a couple years. Competitor automatically includes insurance for envelopes on shipments under $20, CollX makes the seller pay. Great for buyers, not so much for sellers. Never felt less supported as a seller, do better!

reviews.title: Infuriating Customer Service
reviews.text:
I have been a paying Pro member on this platform for multiple years, and while most of my purchases have gone smoothly, my experiences with customer service have been consistently frustrating whenever an issue arises.

When making purchases on a platform of this size, encountering fraudulent sellers or counterfeit cards is an unfortunate reality. What matters is how the platform handles these situations and protects its customers. Unfortunately, resolving these issues has been an unnecessarily exhausting process. Despite supposedly having access to “priority” customer service as a Pro member, I have routinely faced delays spanning multiple days, with responses often limited to a single message per day at best. Resolving even straightforward issues becomes a drawn-out ordeal.

My experience dealing with one particular customer service representative, Tim, has been especially frustrating. Most recently, after a dispute involving counterfeit cards I received, the platform blocked my payment methods entirely. Despite being a paying member for multiple years and maintaining a strong positive rating, I was left unable to use the platform without what appeared to be any meaningful outreach, explanation, or attempt to investigate the underlying issue.

It is incredibly disappointing to be treated this way after years of paid membership and positive transaction history. Rather than feeling that my loyalty is valued or that I have access to better support as a Pro member, I feel penali

reviews.title: Smells fishy
reviews.text:
I wanted to like the app but after uploading a few cards, I had tons of people start following me. Thats fine and all, but the real problem is that one would think “hey, since I’m gaining all these followers, maybe my cards have been getting views or offers”. Not the case at all. Instead, a majority of the followers just want to promote their own page so I would get messages about how their cards are on sell or about how they have any card I may be longing for. It just comes off as slimy and spammy. There comes a point where one would ask “ what did I do to gain 50 followers in a few days? Do people just follow to say hi?”

I ended up deleting my account and the app because I felt it was a scam. And some of the accounts that followed me seemed fake. There was no intent to actually make an offer or show interest in any of the cards I posted. Honestly, only follow if you’re actually interested.
Worthless unless you want to pay $10 a month just to keep an inventory.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This entire app is a racket. They cater to young kids. They push this on kids at conventions like Fanatics Fest. They let them make transactions with real money. CollX is quick to ban accounts for next to nothing; including attempting a login from outside the United States. If you do this, it will trigger as auto ban resulting in account shut down and funds vanishing. This is a total sham that takes advantage of minors. I attempted to remedy this for months to no avail. The customer service is completely rude and unhelpful. They are a BIG part of what’s wrong with the sports card industry! CollX is infamous in the Reddit community. Check it out for yourself! Think twice before dealing with these people if you want to avoid annoyance and frustration!

reviews.title: Devs are single handedly driving this app into the ground
reviews.text: This app used to be great. Community, selling, buying, helpful ambassadors. But recently they have gone off the deep end with AI moderation and bad updates that bug the app or strip the community away. Some of the most active and helpful sellers have been banned by the AI mods for no given reason. Support does nothing about it after receiving multiple emails. On top of that, none of the scammers ever get banned, half of the ambassador break TOS by selling mystery packs, AND NOTHING IS DONE. The General CollX chat used to be the best part of the app, but recently they’ve taken away the ability to send photos, SO WE CANT EVEN SHARE PICTURES OF OUR COLLECTION NOW. Absolutely horrendous developments, updates, and maintenance by the devs. Sad to see.

reviews.title: Customer support is a joke
reviews.text: So I downloaded this app, really liked it so I signed up for gold. I go to grab a few cards in a bundle and there’s an issue with the credits. So I try to pay for it without credits, no big deal. Well it glitched something in the system. The customer support agent “Jake” was so not helpful. Told me it was a tax info issue for my business, which I already had the information on the app but I put it in as requested. Then I created a new stripe account as requested. Still having the same issue. Mind you the issue wasn’t card declined, it was saying insufficient credit because the system was trying to using my free credits even when I turned them off. So then “Jake” instead of listening to my suggestion of there is an issue with the credit system, ChatGPT said this was the problem from the jump, suggested I didn’t have money on any of the 3 payment options I attempted to use on the app. Before he suggested it the second time, I ordered a card with just credits, then the system immediately let me order the order I originally had intended to order. That app, super cool, kinda wonky at times with the different parallels but with more usage I’m sure it’ll learn more. The people side of it obviously left a lot to be desired and I cancelled my gold immediately. I would love to revisit it in the future but thanks to “Jake” not at the moment.

reviews.title: Better options everywhere & 100% misleading
reviews.text: Valuation of cards is a huge problem with this app. Check many of the completed sales and you will find most are not that actual card. Inventory dies out at larger collections and support can only tell you to install an update when there isn’t one. Then uninstall / reinstall and problem persists. Market needs an autodeny feature on listings and a better search mechanism is even more important as the existing is impossible to navigate. Export collection works well. I would not rely on this app for much citing all these issues. Each make any sort of activity using this app as any sort of step in the process is likely detrimental. Market movers is great for consistently accurate pricing and any other app for inventory since this one simply put will fail when you need it.

reviews.title: So many bugs
reviews.text: I honestly gave CollX a fair shot. I was a rookie buyer/seller but now I’m leaving the app. There was not a single day I used the app that I did not experience some type of issue from broken filtering, down to a broken scanner. The app would freeze a few times a day. Basically if I wanted to use CollX I would always make sure I launched it fresh. Don’t even bother with the filtering because it only works half the time. Also switching between your collection and your listing should automatically update the filters to show you the cards you have for sale or not for sale, I should not have to do this manually. Especially for ten bucks a month. The app has potential but definitely feels like it’s still on the early QA phase. I would not link my bank account with this many issues. Maybe in a year or so it will be worth revisiting but imo should not be a paid for app with this many issues.

reviews.title: A Failed Experiment
reviews.text:
So I decided to set up shop, as it were, and list my collection on here for sale/trade. From the moment you create your shop, you’re peppered by “ambassadors” that try to build you up on the site’s perks and compete for your first sale. Once you actually sell a card to them, however, they vaporize from existence and will ignore you and any further message you send any of them. There’s clearly some kind of incentive for being a new user’s first buyer. Then you get into the meat of the app:
1) You are completely buried in advertisements to go Pro. They will literally pop every few listings and every single time you log on until you do. Just sign up for the free trial and cancel to get rid of most of them (although now they John’s users for their newest Pro tier).
2) The seller market is a ghost town. So many users aren’t active anymore, and the system still lets you make purchases from them. The issue? If you don’t file a return within 30 days, CollX keeps the money you spent on the card and you can’t get it back. Supposedly it’s paid to the seller, who isn’t active anyway so they won’t ever get it, but this is a mechanic that clearly needs to be changed.
3) You get a $10 store credit per month as a Pro member, so that easily explains why the ambassadors are willing to buy a cheap card from you. However, you can’t take the money out. Why? They require a $10 minimum transfer amount, AND they take $2 of it for every transfer as a fee. The $10 card I sold only paid me $7.20 after

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: Tons of inactive users so a lot of the cards for sale never get sent out. A lot of sellers never answer messages if you reach out to them, sometimes they’ll refund an order for no reason whatsoever. You can definitely score some cool cards but 7 out of 10 orders you place will never ship. Also be weary of fake/replica cards, kind of a lot on the marketplace. I’ve gotten burned by fake cards on the app and customer service wouldn’t do anything about it. They also removed when the card was listed, so you have no idea how long it’s been up. Many cards on the app are mislabeled as in not the set the seller thinks it is. It’s an okay app but there’s a lot of improvements they could make. Oh and customer service is very difficult to get a hold of and will ignore your emails for more than a week and sometimes never get back to you at all.

reviews.title: Sellers beware. Will never use app again.
reviews.text: I got on this app to sell some of my older basketball, football and tcg cards. First two sales went normally smaller cards no big deal. My third card was a Kobe Bryant card. $20 card shipped in a CollX provided pwe label. Packaged correctly as I have multiple 1000s of sales across eBay Mercari and tcgplayer. The card made it to the buyers post office via tracking. Then nothing. I communicated with buyer. Never showed up. We took it up with CollX customer service. He asked for a refund I escalated it to support. They said to wait a little longer see if it showed. I reached out two times more times after that to support to get help. Never got any. At this point I moved on $20 whatever I stopped selling on this app. Then almost a whole year later they randomly let refund the buyer. So I reach out again asking about compensation. (Since most platforms will compensate both parties if you use their tracking and labels). Not with CollX first they told me there was no proof I sent the card…. I then supplied them with 8 screenshots of tracking scans messages etc…. Nope I don’t get compensated almost a year after all this because it doesn’t say it was delivered. So seller beware. This platform will NOT have your back under any circumstances.  I have deleted the app and will never use again.

Great Job CollX, you made my most hated app ever, Overall. I hate this app more than I hate the Dallas Cowboys and hope someone sues the CollX app for all the money people have lost on banned accounts!

reviews.title: Longtime Customer Finally gave up!
reviews.text: I’ve been a customer  for three years as a pro member. I’ve always been on board with the app through the highs and lows of the technical issues, which are weekly. There’s an update about every week. I have reached out to customer service about 11 to 12 times over the last month regarding the sorting issues. I have over 20,000 cards scanned into the app and for whatever reason they won’t let you sort by price. They have told me 10 times they have escalated it to customer support but no one responds. I’m sad to say I’m gonna have to finally give up on this app..Also, the latest update with prices have sent everything out of whack. So they finally given up on making this app functional unfortunately
